Flowers, who joined Wells Fargo in 1995, rose through the ranks at the bank, becoming chief credit officer and then chief risk officer in 2022.

"Derek played a pivotal role in strengthening our risk and control framework and fostering the strong risk culture that positions Wells Fargo for continued growth," Chairman and CEO Charlie Scharf said.
